[!dolt] skip
# Test bd create command with structured fields
bd init --prefix test --quiet
bd create 'Test issue' --description 'Repro steps here' --type bug --priority 1 --labels critical,backend --json
extractid ISSUE
jq '.title'
stdout '"Test issue"'
jq '.issue_type'
stdout '"bug"'
jq '.priority'
stdout '^1$'

bd show $ISSUE --json
jq '.[0].issue.title'
stdout '"Test issue"'
jq '.[0].issue.description'
stdout '"Repro steps here"'
jq '.[0].labels | length'
stdout '^2$'
